question: A alone can complete a work in 20/3 days. A and B together can complete it in 5 days. How long will B alone take to complete the work?
solution:
**Given:**

A alone can complete the work in 20/3 days.

A and B together can complete the work in 5 days.

**Formula Used:**

Work done per day by A = (1)/(frac{20){3}}

Work done per day by A and B together = 1/5

Work done per day by B = (Work done per day by A and B together) - (Work done per day by A)

Time taken by B alone to complete the work = (1)/({Work done per day by B)}
